item.title: Gelato 0.1.3446
item.description:
Gelato beta

Thanks for trying the first beta. Everything below works with your tester licence.

What’s in it

  • Import a CSV export of an Eos show file. Colour palettes are filed by gel and by light; any it can’t read a gel from wait in To Match.
  • See the versions of a mix side by side, and choose the one builds use.
  • Build a new show’s palettes in Blind after one confirmation, or export the build as a CSV to import yourself.
  • Add a colour in tech (L602, say), from the app or from a Stream Deck through Companion.
  • Preview a colour on a light from your own command line. Nothing is recorded.
  • Turn on the show-mode lock and nothing is written to the console.
  • Updates: with Settings ▸ Updates ▸ Get beta updates on, each new beta arrives here. Nothing installs while a console is connected.

Not in it yet

  • Buying Gelato. Your tester licence is free for a year.
  • The Companion module in Bitfocus’s list. Ask us for it at the address below.

Feedback

Choose Help ▸ Send Feedback…. It opens an email with your version and any recent crash reports attached. Or write to support@flatfield.co.

Libraries you make from this beta on keep working in every later build.
